subject: Close-date drift & MAP re-derivation — stabilization plan
messages:
From: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@acmehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Lila Shah <lila.shah@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP review — timeline concerns

Thanks Kim and Aditya — appreciate the walkthrough today. We ran the proposed evaluation plan past our clinical IT team and they flagged two procurement items that will push our internal approval by at least 8 business days: vendor risk review and a SOC evidence handoff window. That pushes the go-live past our original 8/10 target.

Can we get a concrete proposal for a re-baselined MAP that preserves our high-priority integration path (HL7 ingestion) and a short list of what Redwood needs to unblock on our side versus what Acme must sign off?

Attaching the redlines our security team returned.

—Carlos
Director, Clinical Integrations
Acme Health

Attachments: acme_security_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@acmehealth.com>, Lila Shah <lila.shah@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP review — timeline concerns

Carlos — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the redlines. I took a first pass with Aditya and Marissa and sketched a short contingency MAP that narrows scope to the two critical paths: HL7 ingestion and auth/KMS signoff.

High-level proposal:
- Re-baseline target: move "soft go" from 2028-08-10 to 2028-08-22 (12 business days) to accommodate your procurement windows.
- Split evaluation into two phases: Phase A (integration + smoke tests) — 2 weeks; Phase B (SLA soak + performance eval) — additional 1 week.
- Redwood deliverables to accelerate: pre-populated SOC evidence bundle and a prioritized remediation log for items that affect run-time privacy (we can deliver the SOC bundle within 48 hours after DocuSign).
- Acme deliverables: signed procurement addendum for limited-scope pilot, and a confirmed KMS integration window (2 business days).

Risk notes (brief):
- If procurement delays push beyond 12 business days we recommend a parallel pilot on a reduced dataset to preserve momentum. That will increase cost by ~5% for dedicated debug GPU hours (we will propose a one-time credit if this occurs).
- SLA acceptance criteria remain unchanged but acceptance window will be conditional on a 72-hour soak after final configuration.

I've attached a draft MAP_v2.xlsx that marks ownership and critical decision gates. Can the Acme team confirm whether procurement can commit to a signature by 2028-07-26 so we can lock the 8/22 baseline?

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx), SLA-Risk-Appendix.pdf (pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Close-date drift & MAP re-derivation — stabilization plan

Kim — forwarding Acme's reply and our draft. Two quick internal asks before we confirm the baseline: 
1) Do we approve the proposed 12 business day re-baseline (8/22) or do we push for the reduced-data parallel pilot (higher cost, lower functional risk)?
2) If procurement misses 7/26 commit, I recommend we auto-trigger the parallel pilot and queue the Credit Review with Ben to offset the incremental dedicated hours.

Notes on cost/credits: parallel pilot ~ +$3k one-time GPU ops; proposed one-time credit cap $2.5k (needs Ben sign-off).

Proposed next steps: Ben, can you confirm if we have latitude to commit to the one-time credit and who owns the approval? If not, I will flag to leadership for a rapid exception.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-date drift & MAP re-derivation — stabilization plan

Thanks team — I reviewed the ask and the numbers. Approve the one-time credit up to $2.5k to keep the pilot on schedule, provided the following constraints are met: 
- Credit is conditional on documentation of procurement delay (email thread or procurement ticket) and an internal post-mortem showing why parallel pilot was required.
- Marketing/Case Study sign-off: Acme must agree to a non-sensitive quote and high-level reference (opt-in) if we are asked for a customer success story; otherwise credit is still allowed but flagged to finance.
- Finance will be notified and will queue a cost alloction memo to the deal (Ben will own).

Kim — you have authority to commit the credit. Aditya — please notify Acme of the conditional approval and push for their signature by 07/26. I will track the finance memo and hold the credit until we receive procurement confirmation or the parallel pilot trigger.

—Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
